tools.name: search_tarot_cards
tools.description: Search the 78-card Rider–Waite–Smith deck by name and return matching cards with the slugs the other tools take. Use this first when you only have a card name.

query.description: Part of a card name in any supported language, e.g. "cups", "lovers", "恋人".

language.description: Language for the answer, as an ISO code. One of: en, es, pt, fr, de, it, nl, da, no, fi, pl, hu, tr, ru, ja, ko, zh, zh-TW, th, vi, hi, id. Defaults to en.

tools.name: get_tarot_card_love_meaning
tools.description: What one tarot card means for love and relationships: upright, reversed, as someone’s feelings, in the context of an ex, plus its yes/no leaning and element. Returns markdown.

slug.description: Card slug, e.g. "the-lovers" or "two-of-cups". Always the English slug.

language.description: Language for the answer, as an ISO code. One of: en, es, pt, fr, de, it, nl, da, no, fi, pl, hu, tr, ru, ja, ko, zh, zh-TW, th, vi, hi, id. Defaults to en.

tools.name: get_venus_sign
tools.description: Compute which zodiac sign Venus stood in on a given date — the placement that describes how somebody loves, as distinct from their Sun sign. Needs only a date. Says so explicitly when Venus changed sign that day and the hour decides. Nothing is stored.

date.description: Date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD. Between 1700 and 2200.

language.description: Language for the answer, as an ISO code. One of: en, es, pt, fr, de, it, nl, da, no, fi, pl, hu, tr, ru, ja, ko, zh, zh-TW, th, vi, hi, id. Defaults to en.

tools.name: get_love_question_answer
tools.description: The long-form answer to one of the most-asked love-tarot questions ("will he come back", "does he miss me", …) and which cards speak to it. Call with no slug to list the available questions. Returns markdown.

slug.description: Question slug, e.g. "will-he-come-back". Omit to list every question.

language.description: Language for the answer, as an ISO code. One of: en, es, pt, fr, de, it, nl, da, no, fi, pl, hu, tr, ru, ja, ko, zh, zh-TW, th, vi, hi, id. Defaults to en.
